G2490.name: Joanan
G2490.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G2490.short: Joanan is listed as an ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

G2489.name: Joanna
G2489.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G2489.brief: A follower of Jesus who supported His ministry
G2489.short: Joanna, the wife of Chuza, was one of the women who followed and supported Jesus during His earthly ministry.

G2491I.name: John
G2491I.desc: Priest living at the time of the New Testament
G2491I.brief: A member of the high priest's family
G2491I.short: John, a member of the high priest's family, was present during Peter and John's questioning before the Sanhedrin.

G2491K.name: John
G2491K.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2491K.short: John, also known as Jonah, was the father of Simon Peter, one of Jesus' closest disciples.

G2491G.name: John
G2491G.desc: Prophet living at the time of the New Testament
G2491G.brief: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus
G2491G.short: John the Baptist was a prophet who preached repentance and baptized many, including Jesus, preparing the way for the Messiah.

G2491H.name: John
G2491H.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2491H.short: John and James, the sons of Zebedee, were among the twelve apostles and part of Jesus' inner circle.

G2494.name: Jonam
G2494.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G2494.short: Jonam, son of Eliakim, was an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

G2497.name: Jorim
G2497.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G2497.short: Jorim is listed as one of the ancestors of Jesus Christ in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

G2424K.name: Joshua
G2424K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G2424K.short: Joshua (or Jose) is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

G2455J.name: Judah
G2455J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G2455J.short: Judah is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

G2455M.name: Judas
G2455M.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2455M.brief: A prophet and leader in the Jerusalem church
G2455M.short: Judas, also known as Barsabbas, was a prophet and respected leader in the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul and Barnabas to Antioch.

G2455K.name: Judas
G2455K.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2455K.brief: The Galilean, a Jewish rebel leader
G2455K.short: Judas the Galilean led a revolt against the Roman census during the time of Quirinius, governor of Syria.

G2455L.name: Judas
G2455L.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2455L.brief: A Christian living on Straight Street in Damascus
G2455L.short: Judas was a Christian living on Straight Street in Damascus, where Saul (Paul) stayed after his conversion.

G2455G.name: Judas
G2455G.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2455G.brief: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus
G2455G.short: Judas, also known as Lebbaeus or Thaddaeus, was one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus Christ.

G2455H.name: Judas
G2455H.desc: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
G2455H.short: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve apostles who betrayed Jesus, leading to His arrest and crucifixion.

G2455I.name: Jude
G2455I.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2455I.brief: A brother of Jesus and author of the epistle
G2455I.short: Jude, a brother of Jesus, was the author of the Epistle of Jude and is mentioned in the lists of Jesus' siblings.

G2456.name: Julia
G2456.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G2456.brief: A Christian woman greeted by Paul in Romans
G2456.short: Julia, along with Philologus and Nereus, was greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

G2457.name: Julius
G2457.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2457.brief: A centurion of the Augustan Cohort
G2457.short: Julius, a centurion of the Augustan Cohort, was responsible for escorting Paul to Rome and showed him kindness during the journey.

G2458.name: Junia
G2458.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G2458.brief: A prominent apostle and relative of Paul
G2458.short: Junia, along with Andronicus, was recognized as a prominent apostle and a relative of Paul who had been imprisoned with him.

G2459G.name: Justus
G2459G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2459G.brief: Titius Justus, a Gentile believer who hosted Paul in Corinth
G2459G.short: Titius Justus, a Gentile worshiper of God, hosted Paul in Corinth after he left the synagogue.

G2459H.name: Justus
G2459H.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2459H.brief: Jesus Justus, a Jewish believer who supported Paul
G2459H.short: Jesus, also called Justus, was one of the few Jewish believers who supported Paul during his imprisonment.

G2404.name: Hierapolis
G2404.brief: City in Phrygia, home to a Christian community
G2404.short: Hierapolis, a city in Phrygia, was home to a Christian community mentioned by Paul in his letter to the Colossians (<ref="Col.4.13">Col.4.13</ref>).

G2430.name: Iconium
G2430.brief: A city in Asia Minor visited by Paul
G2430.short: Iconium, a city in Asia Minor where Paul preached the gospel.

G2401.name: Idumea
G2401.short: Idumea, a region south of Judea, inhabited by Edomites.

G2437.name: Illyricum
G2437.brief: A region where Paul preached the gospel
G2437.short: Illyricum, a region where Paul preached the gospel (<ref="Romans 15:19">Romans 15:19</ref>).

G2482.name: Italy
G2482.brief: A region in southern Europe, home to the Roman Empire
G2482.short: Italy, a region in southern Europe, home to the Roman Empire.

G2454.name: Judaism
G2454.brief: The monotheistic religion of the Jewish people
G2454.short: In <ref="Galatians 1:13-14">Galatians 1:13-14</ref>, Paul refers to his former way of life in Judaism, emphasizing his zealous adherence to the traditions of his ancestors before his conversion to Christianity.
